file_roles.evidence: Diff adds DBUG_ASSERTs in TABLE_LIST::init_one_table checking strlen(name)==length; this is the check that fires in the report, it does not change behaviour.
table_name_parse truncated tbl_buf at '#' but did not update tblnamelen; diff adds `tblnamelen = is_part - tbl_buf;`.

rationale: The assertion in init_one_table fails because open_purge_table got a table name length that still included the partition suffix. table_name_parse in ha_innodb.cc produced the wrong length and is corrected. table.h only adds assertions at the detection site.
